mealBalanceCheck.heading: Meal Balance Check
mealBalanceCheck.subtitle: Messenger / email | £39
mealBalanceCheck.highlight: A quick expert review of your current diet — with personalised suggestions you can start using right away.
mealBalanceCheck.description: This service gives you a clear picture of how balanced your meals are, where you might have gaps in nutrition, and what small changes can make a real difference to your energy levels and overall wellbeing.
mealBalanceCheck.idealIf: You want a simple, affordable starting point — without a full consultation — to understand whether your current diet is working for you.
step1Bullets: Take photos of everything you eat and drink for 5 days
Include meals, snacks, and drinks — no need to weigh anything
step2Bullets: Analyse meal balance, protein, fibre and key nutrient gaps
Check food combinations and meal timing
Identify areas that may affect energy, digestion or mood
step3Bullets: Clear, practical tips you can apply straight away
A guide on how to build balanced meals
Advice on foods and supplements to improve nutrient intake
mealBalanceCheck.followUp: After receiving your feedback, you'll have 3 days of follow-up support via messenger to ask questions and clarify recommendations.
mealBalanceCheck.important: This service provides general nutrition feedback based on your food diary. If you have chronic conditions, digestive disorders, food allergies, or take prescribed medications, a full consultation may be more appropriate.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By booking a consultation or service with Anna Doran Health, you agree to the following terms and conditions:
terms.term1: Cancellation policy: We require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations. If you cancel within 24 hours of your appointment, you will be asked to pay half of the consultation price.
terms.term2: After the initial consultation, if agreed, written materials (meal plans, recommendations, summaries) will be sent to you. Please ask any questions about these materials within 7 days. This does not enter you into an ongoing email support agreement — if you require continued support, please book a follow-up session or coaching programme.
terms.term3: If you have booked the Gut Health Coaching programme (6 sessions), all sessions must be used within a 2-month period from the date of your first session.
terms.term4: The cost of each service is as listed on the website at the time of booking. We do not offer refunds for completed consultations.
terms.term5: As a client, you are responsible for: attending your consultation on time, ensuring a stable internet connection for online sessions, and making any payments due prior to or on the day of the consultation.
terms.term6: As a Registered Dietitian, all services provided will be in full compliance with the professional code of conduct for dietitians as outlined by the British Dietetic Association (BDA) and the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).
terms.term7: All data held will be kept confidential and in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR). Please see our Privacy Policy for full details.
terms.term8: If you are asked for your GP contact details, please be aware that the dietitian may contact your GP to provide feedback on your consultation. Please let us know if you are not happy with this.
terms.term9: In the case of unforeseen circumstances such as illness, your consultation may be cancelled by Anna Doran Health within 24 hours. If this happens, no payment will be due and you will be offered an alternative date as soon as possible.
terms.term10: The information and advice provided during consultations is for educational and informational purposes and does not replace medical advice from your doctor or medical team. Always consult your GP before making significant changes to your diet if you have a medical condition.
terms.contact: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us at contact@annadorandiet.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.effectiveDate: Effective from 28 March 2026. This policy is regularly reviewed and updated.
privacy.intro: This privacy policy sets out how Anna Doran Health uses and protects any personal information that you provide to us. Should we ask you to provide certain information by which you can be identified when using our services, you can be assured that it will only be used in accordance with this privacy policy.
privacy.whyCollect: We collect your personal data because you give us consent to do so, in order to provide our independent nutrition and dietetic services to you. You may also have opted in to receive our newsletter.
privacy.whatCollectHeading: Anna Doran Health may collect the following information
privacy.collect1: Name, date of birth, age, sex, next of kin, GP name and address, marital status, living arrangements and occupation.
privacy.collect2: Contact details: home address, email and telephone numbers.
privacy.collect3: Clinical and health-related information via forms, emails and verbally during a consultation.
privacy.usedFor1: Professional clinical record keeping of client information in accordance with the British Dietetic Association Guidance for Records and Record Keeping.
privacy.usedFor2: Sharing information with relevant healthcare professionals such as your GP or medical team (consent will always be asked before this is done).
privacy.usedForException: In exceptional circumstances, information about a client may be disclosed without consent if it is in the public interest to do so. This might be in circumstances where disclosing the information is necessary to prevent a serious crime or serious harm to other people.
privacy.websiteDataHeading: What information is collected via this website and what it is used for
privacy.websiteData1: When you visit this website, your browsing data may be collected anonymously to help us understand how the site is used. No data is collected which could identify an individual.
privacy.websiteData2: This website uses cookies to help provide a better user experience. You may disable cookies in your browser if you prefer.
privacy.websiteData3: If you subscribe to the newsletter, your email address is stored securely and used only to send you regular updates. You are free to unsubscribe at any time.
privacy.websiteData4: When you submit the contact form, your name, email, selected service, and message are saved securely. A notification containing these details is sent to us via Telegram, a messaging service, so we can respond to your enquiry promptly. By submitting the form, you consent to this transfer.
privacy.control1: We will not distribute, sell or lease your personal information to third parties unless we have your explicit permission or are required by law to do so.
privacy.control2: You may request details of personal information which we hold about you under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR). If you believe that any information we are holding on you is incorrect or incomplete, please contact us as soon as possible and we will promptly correct it.
privacy.control3: Service providers used to store and process information related to carrying out dietetic services all have robust security procedures in place and are GDPR compliant. BDA and HCPC record-keeping guidelines are strictly adhered to for one-to-one consultations.
privacy.retention: Records relating to the care of a client will be stored for eight years, in line with British Dietetic Association Guidance for Records and Record Keeping. Contact form enquiries are retained for 12 months.
privacy.right1: The right to access the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.right2: The right to request correction of any inaccurate data.
privacy.right3: The right to request deletion of your data.
privacy.right4: The right to restrict or object to processing of your data.
privacy.right6: The right to withdraw consent at any time.
privacy.rightsICO: If you are unhappy with how your data has been handled, you have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.
privacy.controller: I (Anna Doran) am the data controller at Anna Doran Health. Please contact me at contact@annadorandiet.com with any queries or requests related to your personal data and I will respond promptly.
